narrative: Reports of Pakistan-mediated talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz drive a sharp collapse in crude prices, lifting risk sentiment and pressuring the dollar; gold higher +1.07%; equities +1.79%; DXY -0.03%; VIX 16.5. USD/JPY holds at 157.78 despite a strong options put skew and 275bp Fed-BoJ carry; USD/CAD firmed to 1.4061 as WTI plunged over 6%. JPY leads G10 this week (+1.557% avg) on risk-premium flows and a positive ESI. Watch the next RBA meeting.
